enNotes: [1985]- An oath in which Allāh swears by time throughout the ages.

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
en: (3) Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
tr: Illal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqqi watawāṣaw biṣ-ṣabr
